properties.title: Core characterization data set: loss, permeability and permittivity
properties.citation: A. Nabih, 'Core characterization data set: loss, permeability and permittivity', GitHub asalahnabih/magneto (MIT); measurements described in A. Nabih et al., IEEE Xplore document 10149511
properties.description: MHz ferrite core loss (sinusoidal, 25 degC, no DC bias) and small-signal permeability / permittivity; independent laboratory data except the DMR96A permeability, which the database marks as a datasheet curve.

provenance.normalization: Jackcess TSV export of the Access tables (derived/EXPORT.json); MHz -> Hz, mT -> T, kW/m^3 -> W/m^3, degC -> K and mm -> m scaled exactly from the exported decimal text; points are joined to their test by ID and permeability / permittivity rows to the characteristics table by CID; rows without an ID / CID are excluded and counted.
